review_basis: Checked against the pinned Bosch PDF pages 8, 24, 25, 27, 28, 32 and 33. The 2000 us observation boundary is accepted as an explicit conservative abstraction, not a claim of exact internal reset timing.
limitations: Calibration bytes are separate synthetic device-instance data, not datasheet defaults.
Reset readiness inside the 2000 us boundary is intentionally out of model.
Only initialization and sleep-mode humidity configuration are covered.
